masteryZone.q: Which is the highest peak in Europe?
masteryZone.sol: Mount Elbrus is the highest peak of Europe, located in the Caucasus range.

masteryZone.q: Which is the highest peak in South America?
masteryZone.sol: Mount Aconcagua is the highest peak in South America.

masteryZone.sol: The Pacific Ocean contains the Ring of Fire.

masteryZone.sol: The Arctic Ocean is the smallest and shallowest.
